name: Pazleum
description:
About This Game

          In the physical world, we've been building 2D jigsaw puzzles of paintings and photographs for decades. In the virtual world we can now assemble stunning 3D jigsaw puzzles of sculptures, ancient statues, historical landmarks, ornate vases, and countless other masterpieces of art and culture. Every puzzle contains historical information about its date, artist and what it represents. In Pazleum, art and History are brought to life, one piece at a time.

          Build the 3D artworks in unique immersive environments that evoke a sense of focus, calm and contemplation. The satisfying sound effects, original music and ambient soundscapes are aimed at deepening your focus and flow state to the maximum. Pazleum expands puzzle-solving with art appreciation and a semi-meditative escape from the everyday.

             Pazleum is a genuinely new genre and we want to shape it alongside the players who get it first. The core loop is solid and the pipeline for creating puzzle content is established, but there's a lot left to build: more sculptures, more difficulty options, rewards, new music, more maps, and systems like a gallery room where you can display your completed pieces. Early Access lets us prioritize what matters most based on real feedback, not assumptions. Come help us carve marble and make the full release a work of art!

             Our Early Access game is comprised of twelve sculptures cut as 3D jigsaw puzzles. Several different eras and civilizations are included - Greek, Roman, Medieval, Egyptian, meso-American, African, Asian and more! Content will be uploaded monthly, with free and paid options. The four sculptures below will be a part of the full release and are included in our demo.

              The familiar puzzle-solving experience you love is made intuitive through a smart orientation system that smoothly aligns each piece to the building surface. If you think about it, that is exactly how you would move the pieces in real life if these were physical puzzles. Simply grab from the board, drag it onto the sculpture, and watch your masterpiece come to life!

              All the extraordinary artworks featured in Pazleum can be enjoyed in extreme resolution, even in entry level computers. These masterpieces would be diminished by typical game-ready generation processes, so we've harnessed cutting-edge 3D content creating pipeline and game engine technology to deliver cinematic-quality puzzles. Build your sculpture while admiring every intricate detail in stunning clarity.

              In Early Access, you can assemble in two maps: a dream-like stylized classic museum room with natural elements and a high resolution scan of a Swedish King's Hall. The levels are either hand-crafted, designed by an artist from scratch or real-life scans embellished to suit our style. We are committed to creating environments that are perfectly aligned with our message and we want to honor the sculpture puzzles to the best of our ability.

                Every puzzle contains historical information about its date, artist and what it represents. We'd love to spark curiosity and have our players learn more about ancient cultures, their discoveries and significance.

Self-Organizing Board

Pieces can be easily sort on the tray in an automatic grid, much as you would rearrange apps in your phone screen. Once there are too many empty slots, press the button on the top right to send all pieces to the top of the tray.

Hint System

Too difficult? Use the sideview window, our 'hot and cold' or the 'hint VFX' options, accessible through the settings menu.

Your Own Art Gallery (Future Addition)

Dedicated level to display and revisit all the sculptures you have completed. Show them with pride! (concept image)

Monthly Content Updates

Free and paid levels and sculpture puzzles added every month. Keep building for as long as you want.

Original Soundtrack

Our team is dedicated to world building. Ancient inspired music meticulously composed and recorded blends antique instruments with modern techniques, achieving a perfect balance between emotional and calming in each track.
short_desc: Assemble 3D jigsaw puzzles of real museum artifacts. Each piece reveals the history behind humanity's masterpieces. A relaxing puzzle game for art lovers.
